{
  "outcome": "REVIEW_REQUIRED",
  "request": {
    "id": "DR-9107",
    "customer": "BlueRiver Logistics (CRM-2051)",
    "product": "NS-500 Industrial Controller (SKU NS-500)",
    "requested_discount": "12%",
    "date": "2026-09-23",
    "requestor": "Michael Torres (VP Sales)",
    "basis": "contract_exception"
  },
  "commercial_eligibility": {
    "status": "not_covered",
    "maximum_discount": null,
    "basis": "The request justifies the discount by reference to the Acme Master Supply Agreement (ACME-MFG-2025). That agreement exists and establishes eligibility for up to 15% discount on NS-500 — but ONLY for Acme Mfg. Holdings (CRM-2048, ERP customer C-1001). BlueRiver Logistics (CRM-2051, C-1002) is a different customer and is not named in the Acme agreement. No contract or pricing exception in the records covers BlueRiver Logistics for NS-500."
  },
  "authority": {
    "policy": "Northstar Pricing Policy 2026 (effective 2026-01-01–2026-12-31)",
    "requestor_limit": "VP Sales: >10% and ≤20%",
    "requestor_authorized": true,
    "required_role": "VP Sales (Michael Torres holds this role)",
    "approver": "Michael Torres (as VP Sales) — but only if commercial eligibility is established"
  },
  "evidence": [
    "documents/acme_master_supply_agreement.md: Agreement explicitly covers Acme Mfg. Holdings only (Section 1; Section 3.2 names Acme as the customer eligible for NS-500 discount)",
    "documents/acme_pricing_exception.md: Exception EXC-ACME-NS500-15 scoped to 'Acme Manufacturing' (Acme Mfg. Holdings) only; effective 2025-04-01–2028-03-31",
    "structured/crm_accounts.csv: CRM-2051 is BlueRiver Logistics (Standard tier); CRM-2048 is Acme Manufacturing (Strategic tier) — distinct customers",
    "structured/customers.csv: C-1002 (Blue River Logistics LLC) and C-1001 (Acme Mfg. Holdings) are separate ERP customers",
    "structured/discount_requests.csv: Acme (CRM-2048) has active NS-500 discount history (15%, e.g., DR-8104, DR-9001); BlueRiver (CRM-2051) has no NS-500 pricing exception or discount history",
    "documents/blueriver_support_terms.md: BlueRiver's only support agreement covers NS-CLOUD, not NS-500"
  ],
  "missing_evidence": [
    "Contract, amendment, or pricing exception covering BlueRiver Logistics for NS-500 discount",
    "Clarification why the Acme Master Supply Agreement is cited as the basis for a BlueRiver discount request"
  ],
  "conditions": [
    {
      "what": "Establish the commercial basis: Provide either (a) a contract or exception covering BlueRiver Logistics for NS-500 discount eligibility, or (b) clarification that the discount rationale is something other than contract pricing (e.g., competitive move, customer acquisition), which would require a different approval path",
      "who": "Michael Torres or Sales team (before approval decision)",
      "blocking": true
    },
    {
      "what": "Confirm this request is for the correct customer. DR-9001 (also dated 2026-09-23, also citing Acme agreement) is for Acme (CRM-2048) at 15%. Verify DR-9107 is not a data-entry error and is intentionally for BlueRiver (CRM-2051)",
      "who": "Michael Torres or Sales Operations",
      "blocking": true
    }
  ]
}
```

**Summary:** Michael Torres cannot approve this discount. Although Michael Torres (as VP Sales) has authority to approve a 12% discount under the 2026 policy, the request's commercial eligibility has not been established. The justification cites the Acme Master Supply Agreement, which covers only Acme Mfg. Holdings (a different customer, CRM-2048). No contract or pricing exception extends to BlueRiver Logistics (CRM-2051) for NS-500. Commercial review is required to clarify the legitimate basis for discounting this customer on this product before any approval decision can proceed.
